readings.moment: When the temple struck ten (watch showed four minutes to ten)
He went out into the street
The piano started up in the salon as he lit his cigar
He heard faint quick bells from the master's window (twenty-six minutes to eleven)
The piano stopped (eighteen minutes to eleven)
He came back into the house (fourteen minutes to eleven)
The hall clock had just struck eleven when he came back in
The hall clock's face showed two minutes past eleven when he came back in

durations: 13 minutes: the piano played from 10:29 to 10:42 by Bastien's watch
25 minutes: Girard was out in the street from 10:21 to 10:46 by his watch
whereabouts: Girard came to dinner because Monnier asked him
At dinner, Monnier laughed at Girard across the table when Girard offered for the movement, and they quarrelled about the price
After dinner Girard sat alone in the dining room with the brandy
Girard went out into the street at 10:21 by his watch
Girard stayed under the front windows of the house while in the street
Girard lit a cigar in the street
The piano was being played in the salon while Girard was in the street; Girard did not see who played it
Girard came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch
Girard went upstairs to Félix in the library
Girard did not play cards with Dr Vauthier this evening
